name: com.timbojimbo.ui.layout
description: A layout engine for UGUI, modelled on Clay: fit, grow, fixed and percent sizing, padding, gap, alignment, floating elements and aspect ratios, computed as a pure pass and committed to RectTransforms once.

samples.description: Start here: one small scene with a list, a row of tabs and three buttons. Each button makes one change inside a view transition (add a row, remove a row, turn the list on its side) and a tab moves the highlight, so you can see the README's first recipes working.
A showcase scene: the sizing modes, alignment, shrink and wrap, floating, aspect ratio and a scrolling list, with buttons that add rows, flip a direction, change a gap and pulse an Offset.

A scene of stages that show each view transition feature on its own (layout changes, enter and exit, an animator, delay, a node's own transition, reparenting, named pairs, scopes, persist) and then composed: a card opening into a page spawned from a prefab, and the same insertion with and without a transition.
